tests.name: Place active ship at actual StarDock and create a separately owned replacement

data.sql: WITH yard AS (SELECT p.port_id,p.sector_id FROM ports p JOIN porttypes pt USING(porttype_id) WHERE pt.is_stardock=TRUE ORDER BY p.port_id LIMIT 1), moved AS (UPDATE players SET sector_id=(SELECT sector_id FROM yard) WHERE name='ship_sale_atomic_qa' RETURNING player_id,ship_id), active AS (UPDATE ships SET sector_id=(SELECT sector_id FROM yard),ported=(SELECT port_id FROM yard),fighters=4,installed_shields=2,shields=2,mines=3,ore=7 WHERE ship_id=(SELECT ship_id FROM moved) RETURNING ship_id,type_id,sector_id), replacement AS (INSERT INTO ships(name,type_id,sector_id,holds,fighters,shields) SELECT 'Atomic sale replacement',type_id,sector_id,10,0,0 FROM active RETURNING ship_id), owner AS (INSERT INTO ship_ownership(ship_id,player_id,role_id,is_primary) SELECT replacement.ship_id,moved.player_id,1,TRUE FROM replacement CROSS JOIN moved RETURNING ship_id) SELECT active.ship_id,owner.ship_id FROM active CROSS JOIN owner;
INSERT INTO ship_cargo(ship_id,commodity_code,quantity) VALUES(@{sale_ship_id},'ORE',7) ON CONFLICT(ship_id,commodity_code) DO UPDATE SET quantity=7;

tests.name: Create active ship insurance before sale

data.sql: INSERT INTO insurance_policies(holder_type,holder_id,subject_type,subject_id,premium,payout,start_ts,active) SELECT 'player',player_id,'ship',@{sale_ship_id},25,500,CURRENT_TIMESTAMP::text,TRUE FROM players WHERE name='ship_sale_atomic_qa';

SELECT p.credits,p.ship_id,(SELECT quantity FROM ship_cargo WHERE ship_id=@{sale_ship_id} AND commodity_code='ORE'),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ship_ownership WHERE ship_id=@{sale_ship_id}),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM insurance_policies WHERE subject_type='ship' AND subject_id=@{sale_ship_id} AND active=TRUE),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ship_sale_audit WHERE ship_id=@{sale_ship_id}),(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipyard_used_inventory WHERE ship_id=@{sale_ship_id}),s.fighters,s.installed_shields,s.mines FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=@{sale_ship_id} WHERE p.name='ship_sale_atomic_qa';
CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION v3_ship_sale_fail_audit() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $$ BEGIN RAISE EXCEPTION 'controlled SHIP-03 rollback'; END $$;

tests.name: Fail after credits cargo insurance and ownership have changed inside sale transaction

data.sql: CREATE TRIGGER v3_ship_sale_fail_audit BEFORE INSERT ON ship_sale_audit FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION v3_ship_sale_fail_audit();

tests.name: Ordinary player sale rolls back on injected audit failure
Verify every sale effect rolled back

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.credits=@{before_credits} AND p.ship_id=@{before_active_ship} AND (SELECT quantity FROM ship_cargo WHERE ship_id=@{sale_ship_id} AND commodity_code='ORE')=@{before_ore} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ship_ownership WHERE ship_id=@{sale_ship_id})=@{before_owners} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM insurance_policies WHERE subject_type='ship' AND subject_id=@{sale_ship_id} AND active=TRUE)=@{before_active_policies} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ship_sale_audit WHERE ship_id=@{sale_ship_id})=@{before_audits} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipyard_used_inventory WHERE ship_id=@{sale_ship_id})=@{before_used_inventory} AND s.fighters=@{before_fighters} AND s.installed_shields=@{before_shields} AND s.mines=@{before_mines} THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=@{sale_ship_id} WHERE p.name='ship_sale_atomic_qa';

tests.name: Remove injected trigger to permit retry
Remove injected function to permit retry
Retry sale after rollback and persist one receipt
Verify successful retry preserves installed equipment and commits cargo insurance ownership credits and inventory exactly once

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.credits=@{before_credits}+@{sale_proceeds} AND p.ship_id=@{replacement_ship_id} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ship_cargo WHERE ship_id=@{sale_ship_id}) AND s.ore=0 AND s.fighters=@{before_fighters} AND s.installed_shields=@{before_shields} AND s.mines=@{before_mines} AND NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM ship_ownership WHERE ship_id=@{sale_ship_id}) AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM insurance_policies WHERE subject_type='ship' AND subject_id=@{sale_ship_id} AND active=TRUE)=0 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ship_sale_audit WHERE ship_id=@{sale_ship_id})=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipyard_used_inventory WHERE ship_id=@{sale_ship_id})=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p JOIN ships s ON s.ship_id=@{sale_ship_id} WHERE p.name='ship_sale_atomic_qa';

tests.name: Duplicate sale retry cannot settle a second receipt
Verify duplicate retry did not alter credits or create another record

data.sql: SELECT CASE WHEN p.credits=@{before_credits}+@{sale_proceeds} AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ship_sale_audit WHERE ship_id=@{sale_ship_id})=1 AND (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM shipyard_used_inventory WHERE ship_id=@{sale_ship_id})=1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END FROM players p WHERE p.name='ship_sale_atomic_qa';
